description: List rental orders. Filter by free-text search (order number, customer name/email/address, tags, custom fields), status, payment status, customer, or rental-period range. Booqable: GET /api/4/orders.

customer_id.description: Only orders for this customer id.

include.description: Comma-separated relationships to sideload, e.g. customer,start_location,stop_location.

payment_status.description: Only orders with this payment status.

q.description: Search: order number (exact), customer name, e-mail, address, tags, custom field values.

sort.description: Sort, comma-separated attributes; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -created_at.

starts_at_gte.description: Rental starts at or after this datetime (ISO 8601).

starts_at_lte.description: Rental starts at or before this datetime (ISO 8601).

status.description: Only orders with this simplified status.

stops_at_gte.description: Rental ends at or after this datetime (ISO 8601).

stops_at_lte.description: Rental ends at or before this datetime (ISO 8601).

name: booqable_list_orders
title: List orders
